description: This file defines the EmployeeBoardingController class for managing employee onboarding and separation processes, including project and task creation, holiday handling, and status updates within the ERPNext system.

classes.name: EmployeeBoardingController
classes.description: Controller class for handling employee onboarding and separation workflows, including project/task creation, holiday adjustments, and status updates.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Removes linked activities' tasks if the document is amended before submission.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Creates a project for onboarding/separation, sets status, and initiates task creation and notification.

methods.name: create_task_and_notify_user
methods.description: Generates tasks for activities, assigns users based on roles, and notifies them.

methods.name: get_holiday_list
methods.description: Retrieves the holiday list relevant to the employee or separation process.

methods.name: get_task_dates
methods.description: Calculates start and end dates for tasks, adjusting for holidays.

methods.name: update_if_holiday
methods.description: Shifts dates forward if they fall on a holiday.

methods.name: assign_task_to_users
methods.description: Assigns tasks to specified users and sends notifications.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Deletes associated tasks and project upon cancellation.
